Arrange the given satellites chronologically based on their year of launch.
(A) Aryabhata
(B) Bhaskara-1
(C) Rohini
(D) INSAT 1-B
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
NCERT Class 12 India: People and Economy (Chapter 8: Transport and Communication, 'Satellite Communication'): (A) Aryabhata was India's first satellite, launched on 19 April 1975; (B) Bhaskara-I was launched on 7 June 1979 for Earth observation experiments; (C) Rohini (RS-1) was launched on 18 July 1980 using India's indigenous SLV-3 rocket; (D) INSAT-1B was launched on 30 August 1983, establishing India's domestic telecommunication and weather monitoring network. Chronological sequence: (A), (B), (C), (D).
Hence, option (D) is correct.

questionText:

(A) Opening of the Panama Canal
(B) Opening of the Suez Canal
(C) Completion of the Trans-Siberian Railway
(D) First passenger railway service in Britain (Stockton to Darlington)

1. Stockton to Darlington railway opened in 1825 (D).

3. Trans-Siberian Railway completed across Russia in 1904/1916 (C).
4. Panama Canal opened in 1914 (A).
Hence, Option B is correct.
